name: Trees Are Strictly Uniform-Oriented-Matroid Fibers
scope: Finite classes with fixed coordinates suppressed.
statement: Every finite tree is a maximum VC-at-most-one class and admits a realizable rank-three uniform-oriented-matroid fiber presentation; the inclusion is strict.
proof: The disjoint-chord construction realizes every edge-labeled finite tree as a topal fiber. The square is a cube and hence belongs to UOMFib, but it is not a tree.
